sections.heading: FAQ PAGE

items.title: Is there a 24/7 Clinic inside my hotel?
items.text: Use the Find a Clinic page or contact us on WhatsApp and send your hotel name.

items.title: Do you accept travel insurance?
items.text: We work with international travel insurers and assistance companies. Coverage depends on the patient’s policy.

items.title: Can my treatment be cashless?
items.text: Cashless treatment may be available where approved by the insurer and subject to policy conditions.

items.title: Do I need to contact my insurance company first?
items.text: Not always. Send us your insurance details and our team can advise you on the next step.

items.title: What should I send you on WhatsApp?
items.text: Please send your name, hotel, location, brief description of the medical problem and insurance information if available.

items.title: Can a doctor come to my hotel room?
items.text: Hotel room medical visits may be arranged depending on location, availability and medical condition.

items.title: What conditions can you treat at the hotel clinic?
items.text: Our clinics can assess and treat many urgent and primary medical conditions, minor injuries and other conditions that do not require hospital-level care.

items.title: Can you arrange an ambulance?
items.text: Yes. If ambulance transport is medically necessary, our team can coordinate it.

items.title: What happens if I need a hospital?
items.text: If hospital-level diagnostics, treatment or admission are required, our team can coordinate the appropriate hospital referral.

items.title: Can you provide documentation for my insurance?
items.text: Yes. Medical reports, invoices and other required documentation can be provided according to the case and insurer requirements.

items.title: What if my hotel does not have a 24/7 Clinic?
items.text: Contact our coordination team on WhatsApp and we will advise you about the nearest available medical solution.
